snippet.title: Bunni: How We First Met - Flash Game Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
Bunni: How We First Met is a flash game about rebuilding a destroyed Bunni Island.  A great and unknown catastrophe struck, work with the Bunni's and creatures of the Island to save everyone!

Bunni is one of the best flash games ever released.  It also has quite a long story, and history that I'll explain too.  It's a short and sweet building RPG where you get to rebuild an island, and decorate it.  There's many fun and random items you can get from shaking the tree's too, delivering many surprises.

Although titled Bunni: How We First Met, the flash file is called "Land of Bunnies" and was also referred to as Bunni Bunni for a while.  It was sort of a beta game when it was released, some parts aren't 100% complete it seems.  Though it is complete enough to have fun and win in the end.

Unfortunately it's impossible to get 100% of all motes, since the save function is broken.  The game used to run from an external server.  Then that server and the website of the original developer went down, and the game was unplayable for a long time. 

Luckily, the game was later revived, but the save function could not be brought back, since it was only designed to work with the original server.  I can't remember if anything happens when you collect every mote, please let me know if something does.

The two finale scenes are the wedding with Coriander, and the dance with Pirate Peach.  I had to do some editing tricks to since it up with the resolution of the game.  the resolution of the game is 800x600, but the flash movie scenes are 640x480.

The monster den might be an item that you weren't supposed to get.  It doesn't do anything, though I assume it was meant to be a shop to buy the monsters from.  It seems this item was never completed.

I was able to play this game with the latest version of flash that doesn't have the built in killswitch timer.  It's also available on BlueMaxima's Flashpoint, but that uses the flash debug projector which had some lag while selecting objects and moving around too much.


#Gaming #FlashGames #Flash
